actual_review.execution: These three independent mathematical reviews were read-only. No additional numerical experiment or replay is asserted. The earlier published d86 exact runs retain their own execution records.

pointwise_identity.domain: Same finite nonempty original labelled common menu, same legal unit-customer model, same complete pure strategy, same actual ordered prefixes, same full m-slot forced continuations, and one independent common distribution p.
pointwise_identity.identity: For every fixed column A, E_T K_i(T,A)=sum_x Pr_p[x in T]/(1+c_x(Z_i(A)))=G_p(Z_i(A)). Hence the original finite-menu minima satisfy R_i(p)=psi_i(p), with identical argmin sets.
pointwise_identity.whole_scope: The two universal open budget propositions are equivalent in both directions. The mathematical identity is complete; neither universal budget becomes proved.
pointwise_identity.tax_distinction: tau_i=sum_x t_x E[I/(c(c+1))] is the SUMmin insertion discount; s_i=sum_x E[I/(c(c+1))] is the uniform-covariance self-tax; g_i=C_i(full)-R_i is the reselect credit. kappa_i+tau_i=sum_x Cov(I,1/(1+c))+s_i. Distinct labels, even those with identical coverage or zero p mass, remain legal min columns.
pointwise_identity.tail_bridge: Reuse ca-r34-tail-reserves-pay-two-prefix-positions as the existing unconditional contribution. Do not duplicate the same paid-tail proof.
pointwise_identity.remaining_equivalence: For m>=2, SUMmin is equivalent to sum_{i<=m-2}(P_i-u_i) <= T_tail+sum_all_i g_i, where P_i=E_{A,T iid p} K_i(T,A), g_i=P_i-R_i>=0, and T_tail=e_pen+L_BR+V+Q+e_last+V_last. At m=6 the unpaid positions are 1 through 4.
pointwise_identity.six_half_boundary: The weaker all-input/all-complete-SPE condition M_path=max_p min_i R_i(p)<=W/6 is sufficient with the already-proved static OPT_6<=12 M_path bridge. Uniform-time and path-optimised time values are distinct. The Jensen helper does not compare its reserve automatically with sum_i g_i.

all_spe_joint_contribution.fixed_input: For every n>=3, use precisely CA source F and integer inverse x_B, P=X disjoint-union Y with |X|=|Y|=n, M=sum_{nonempty B}|x_B|, K=6M+4, and r_B=K+x_B>0.
all_spe_joint_contribution.parameter_transfer: For every ordered history, induct on remaining depth over all true SPE child continuations. Bias-only permutation of unused labels aligns the two fresh suffix sets while fixing used labels. Even when the old child uses the chosen fresh label, the bias comparison is at least 1/2. The two original signed payoffs each have absolute value <=M; do not permute signed weights or freeze a continuation. Therefore fresh-old >=K/2-2M=M+2>0. Every complete original SPE chooses fresh at every decision history, including histories with earlier repetition.
all_spe_joint_contribution.actual_leaf: Every complete original SPE therefore has n distinct actual labels Z. Forced old columns may still have a repetition; they stay in the original menu and are not needed for the upper bound.
all_spe_joint_contribution.uniform_prices: C=2^(2n)-2^n; beta=(2^(2n)-2^(n-1))/(n+1); gamma=((n-1)2^(2n)+2^n)/(n(n+1)); delta=C-n beta=n(beta-gamma)>n. Extra-query uniform price is beta on unused labels and gamma on used labels.
all_spe_joint_contribution.signed_welfare: By the source-internal Boolean harmonic identity, u_a^x=F(Z)-F(Z without a). Pure leaves have signed welfare n; 1/(n-1) mixed leaves have n-1; leaves with both group sizes >=2 have n. Hence W>=KC+n-1, without claiming equality for every SPE.
all_spe_joint_contribution.exact_max_query: For unused a, the Boolean increment gives s_a=F(Z union a)-F(Z)=-F(Z), with F(Z) in {0,1}. For used a, only use |s_a|<=M because duplication is not Boolean. K gamma+M<K beta-1<=K beta-F(Z), so max_a Q_a(Z)=K beta-F(Z).
all_spe_joint_contribution.common_p_argument: For each fixed complete sigma and row i, choosing its own actual action S_i after its actual prefix reproduces z: Z_i(S_i)=z. Thus R_i(p)<=E_p Q_a(z) for the same arbitrary p. The chosen column is independent of the sampled query; no min/expectation exchange occurs.
all_spe_joint_contribution.result: For every complete original pure SPE sigma of this fixed input and every common p: sum_i R_i(p)<=n E_p Q_a(z)<=n[K beta-F(Z)]<=nK beta<W(sigma), with uniform slack >=K delta+n-1.
all_spe_joint_contribution.independent_coarse_proof: W>=KC-M and sum R<=n(K beta+M); their difference is at least K delta-(n+1)M>nK-(n+1)M=(5n-1)M+4n>0. The welfare error must be included.
all_spe_joint_contribution.scope: The accepted two-source ALL edge is an unconditional contribution, not a whole general SUMmin theorem. It strengthens the strategy quantifier for this exact input family. It does not prove the 36-customer case for every strategy, another F or K, arbitrary inputs, or unconditional six-player half. The earlier d86 specified-strategy edge remains correct and unchanged.
all_spe_joint_contribution.evidence_role: M1 is checked as exact source evidence. The needed inversion and all-Boolean harmonic identity already occur self-contained in the CA body, so no missing third independent source premise is concealed.
